questions.cardText:
[Philosophy] “Agnosticism” is the view that:
A. There is no deity
B. The existence of a deity is unknown or unknowable
C. Multiple gods exist
Answer: B.
questions.de: Wie heißt die Auffassung, dass die Existenz Gottes oder einer Gottheit unbekannt oder unerkennbar ist?
questions.en: What is the view called that the existence of God or any deity is unknown or unknowable?

timeline.labelEn: Thomas Henry Huxley coins the word 'agnosticism' in a speech to the Metaphysical Society
timeline.labelDe: Thomas Henry Huxley prägt das Wort „Agnostizismus“ in einer Rede vor der Metaphysical Society

questions.notes: Reworked to ask the term for the definition the card gives as its answer.

questions.cardText:
[Agronomy] Which ancient civilization is known for creating floating gardens, known as chinampas, for agriculture?
A. Aztec B. Maya C. Inca
Answer: A. Chinampas were constructed by layering mud and vegetation on shallow lake beds, creating fertile plots that allowed the Aztecs to grow crops like maize, tomatoes, chili peppers, and even flowers. They significantly increased agricultural yields and supported the large population of the Aztec capital, Tenochtitlan.
questions.de: Welche Zivilisation bewirtschaftete die Seen des Tals von Mexiko in großem Stil mit Chinampas, den „schwimmenden Gärten“, die ihre Hauptstadt Tenochtitlan ernährten?
questions.en: Which civilization farmed the lakes of the Valley of Mexico on a large scale with chinampas, the 'floating gardens' that fed its capital Tenochtitlan?

timeline.labelEn: The Aztec Triple Alliance rules central Mexico, its capital Tenochtitlan fed by chinampas
timeline.labelDe: Der aztekische Dreibund beherrscht Zentralmexiko; seine Hauptstadt Tenochtitlan wird von Chinampas ernährt

questions.notes: Card is right on the civilization, but the Aztecs did not invent chinampas — they were the first to use them for large-scale cultivation (Wikipedia); 'ancient' is loose for the Aztec Empire (1428–1521).
